title: Mega Menu List
description: The query-driven link column inside a mega-menu panel — the tour and special lists that sit beside the navigation columns. Carries the resting row contract: flush rows, a hairline between them, and body type at the navigation row's weight and rhythm, so a query row and a navigation row read as one list. This is the counterpart to styles/blocks/navigation/mega-menu-nav.json; the two describe the same row on different markup and have to be changed together. Hover and :focus-visible cannot live in this file's css field — WordPress strips :hover out of it entirely — so they sit in assets/styles/ollie-mega-menu.css alongside the navigation half.
